items.name: UBLK_U_CMD_ADD_DEV
items.summary: Create a device: allocates `/dev/ublkcN` and negotiates queues, depth, buffer size and feature flags.
items.details: `addr` points to a `struct ublksrv_ctrl_dev_info` (64 bytes) that the kernel reads and writes back with the negotiated values. `dev_id` in the header must match `info.dev_id`; pass `U32_MAX` to auto-assign. The legacy opcode `UBLK_CMD_ADD_DEV` (0x04) exists since 6.0.

items.name: UBLK_U_CMD_GET_FEATURES
items.summary: Report the `UBLK_F_*` features this kernel supports, without needing a device.
items.details: `addr` points to an 8-byte buffer and `len` must be exactly `UBLK_FEATURES_LEN` (8).

items.name: UBLK_U_CMD_QUIESCE_DEV
items.summary: Quiesce a live device so a new server can take over through user recovery.
items.details: `data[0]` is a timeout in milliseconds; 0 waits forever. Returns `-EBUSY` if every tag stays busy for the whole timeout.

items.name: UBLK_U_IO_FETCH_REQ
items.summary: Arm a tag: the command completes when the kernel has a request for that tag.
items.details: Issued once per tag at startup. The issuing task becomes the tag's daemon.

items.name: UBLK_U_IO_NEED_GET_DATA
items.summary: Supply a buffer for a WRITE delivered without its data.

go_ublk.notes: The runner fails the queue if the kernel returns `UBLK_IO_RES_NEED_GET_DATA`.

items.name: UBLK_F_SUPPORT_ZERO_COPY
items.summary: Zero copy through io_uring fixed buffers (`REGISTER_IO_BUF`).
items.details: Defined since 6.0; functional since 6.15, when `UBLK_U_IO_REGISTER_IO_BUF` was added.

go_ublk.notes: `EnableZeroCopy` sets the flag but the data plane does not register buffers.

items.name: UBLK_F_URING_CMD_COMP_IN_TASK
items.summary: Complete I/O commands through `io_uring_cmd_complete_in_task`.

items.name: UBLK_F_USER_RECOVERY
items.summary: Keep `/dev/ublkbN` alive across a server exit so a new server can recover it.

items.name: UBLK_F_QUIESCE
items.summary: Enables `UBLK_U_CMD_QUIESCE_DEV`.

items.name: UBLK_F_SHMEM_ZC
items.summary: Shared-memory zero copy: requests whose pages match a registered buffer arrive by index and offset.

items.name: UBLK_PARAM_TYPE_BASIC
items.summary: Size, block sizes, maximum request size and attributes. Mandatory.

items.name: UBLK_PARAM_TYPE_ZONED
items.summary: Zone limits for a zoned device.

items.name: UBLK_IO_OP_READ
items.summary: Read `nr_sectors` 512-byte sectors starting at `start_sector`.

items.name: UBLK_IO_OP_WRITE_SAME
items.summary: Defined in the UAPI but never generated by current kernels.

items.name: UBLK_IO_F_FUA
items.summary: Write must be durable before it completes. Sent only if the device advertises `UBLK_ATTR_FUA`.

go_ublk.notes: FUA is not advertised; the block layer emulates it with a post-flush.

items.name: UBLK_S_DEV_QUIESCED
items.summary: No server; new I/O is queued until a recovered server ends recovery.

items.name: UBLK_ATTR_VOLATILE_CACHE
items.summary: The device has a volatile write cache, so the kernel sends FLUSH.

items.name: ublksrv_io_desc
items.summary: Per-tag request descriptor in the read-only mmap of `/dev/ublkcN`.

items.name: ublksrv_io_desc.start_sector
items.summary: First sector of the request, always in 512-byte units.

items.name: ublk_param_integrity
items.summary: Integrity (protection information) limits.

items.name: UBLK_MAX_QUEUE_DEPTH
items.summary: Maximum tags per queue; also sets the fixed stride of the per-queue descriptor mmap.
